notes.title: Welcome to Blackroot: Medieval Survival
notes.content:
Hello, survivors!

Blackroot is a brutal survival game set in a dark medieval world where the dead no longer stay dead. After a strange plague swept the land, people began to change. What seemed like an ordinary sickness turned out to be something far more terrifying.

This is a solo indie project, developed with passion and commitment. The game will grow and evolve together with the community during Early Access, based on your feedback, suggestions, and ideas. From survival mechanics to world design and story elements—your voice will help shape the future of Blackroot.

If you're drawn to:

[list]
[*]     gritty medieval survival with a sci-fi horror twist
[*]     exploring ruined villages and dark forests
[*]     building, crafting, and fighting to stay alive
[/list]

then add Blackroot to your wishlist and join the journey.

We're currently preparing the first gameplay trailer, which will be revealed soon—stay tuned!

Thank you for your support—and welcome to Blackroot.
